literal_meaning: ধাতুতে স্থাপিত বা শারীরিক ধাতুর ভারসাম্যপূর্ণ অবস্থা
figurative_meaning_en: calm, composed, or recovered to normal state
example_sentences_in_bangla: আঘাতের পর সে ধাতস্থ হতে সময় নিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: I've finally regained my composure after the shock.
It took him time to recover and become composed after the accident.
history: Derived from Ayurvedic terminology referring to the balance of bodily humors (dhatus), indicating restoration to health or mental equilibrium.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Indian medical concepts integrated into Bengali language.
